image_description: A close-up photograph of an adult guenon monkey holding a juvenile. The adult has olive-brown fur with a lighter underbelly and a distinctive facial ruff. The face is bare with forward-facing eyes. The juvenile is nestled against the adult's chest, looking towards the viewer. Both subjects exhibit primate anatomy including visible limbs and tails.

Both the adult and juvenile have forward-facing eyes. The irises appear dark brown, consistent with the species.
The nasal structure is narrow and prominent, typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are visible on the adult, appearing small and partially hidden by the facial ruff.
